blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Nest retains issuer / admin authority over vault shares with permissioned issuance and freeze surfaces beyond reserve-only exposure.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: nOPAL is listed across issuer-controlled deployments and Nest docs do not expose a separate public bridge topology. The reviewed route is issuer-native multichain issuance with probable confidence pending more explicit chain-route documentation.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal)

routes.reviewNote: Native nOPAL (7,935-byte code, same address on all chains): owner() = 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a — a 5,450-byte Nest vault owner contract on every chain (read 2026-07-20). Nest issues nOPAL natively per chain under the vault owner Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 (3-of-6, mint-authority review).
